status_note: The locked same-input/same-output fixture is MATCH for the targeted Action/Rule breakpoint, ordinary ActionGroup cursor, ActionPool live-tree resume/dead-cleanup, lookup, and synthetic virtual-reset projections. The production call closure remains MISMATCH: concrete Action/Rule reset overrides outside this write-set do not yet adopt the companion-state seam, ActionRestartGroup does not pass its inherited state into the embedded group, derived-root Rule clone filtering is absent, and PcodeOpBank::create has a pre-existing alive/dead lifecycle mismatch.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: ActionState and RuleState externalize Ghidra base-class fields by mutable reference; retained Group/Pool cursors and Funcdata/PcodeOp mutations survive a -1 return and are resumed in place.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: Groups traverse child insertion order. Pools fetch rule_index++ before skip/test/apply and dynamically reconstruct the strict successor in the live address-then-time PcodeOpTree; insertions after the cursor are visited, insertions before it wait for the next pass.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: Start-break precedes Action count_tests; enabled Rule attempts increment tests once, positive results increment applies once and add the exact result; warnings precede break checks; reset preserves counts/statistics/breakpoints and resetStats alone clears statistics.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: PcodeOpTree order is SeqNum address followed by immutable creation time, independent of basic-block order; Action/Rule lookup compares exact names after stripping at most one first-colon container prefix and treats ambiguity locally per level.

action_break_warning_resume.covers: persistent+temporary start/action bits, -1, one-time temporary clearing, warning and counter timing, status_actionbreak resume, reset/resetStats

group_cursor.covers: group-owned persistent action break advances child cursor; child negative result retains cursor; completion performs the inherited action-break check

pool_live_resume_dead.covers: retained op_state/rule_index, disabled rule, exact result count, live before/after insertion, dead entry advance-before-destroy, warning and Rule break resume

lookup_ambiguity.covers: first-colon prefix stripping, exact names, duplicate null, and locally ambiguous subtree ignored in favor of a unique immediate sibling

virtual_reset_dispatch.covers: The synthetic Rule seam matches normal reset and an override omitting Rule::reset; production Action/Rule override implementations outside this write-set are not wired to that seam.

restart_group_inherited_breakpoint.covers: Ordinary ActionGroup child-boundary breakpoints match, but ActionRestartGroup does not forward its inherited ActionState into the embedded group.

derived_root_clone_filtering.covers: ActionPool Rule clone filtering for non-default derived roots is outside this batch.

opbank_creation_lifecycle.covers: Explicit dead entries and dead-and-gone cleanup match; PcodeOpBank::create still starts new Rust ops alive instead of dead.
